title: Lockpick Minigame
description: Mini-games the GM requests for a character from a chat card: lockpicking (Thieves' Tools check) and three Arcana challenges (Unweave the Ward, Attune the Resonance, Trace the Sigil), where the roll sets the difficulty, with live spectating. Plus puzzles (Sudoku, Sliding, Cipher, Rune Sequence) for Foundry VTT.
